selected_build_inputs.limits: These pins establish the generated driver and selected object inputs relevant to error/restore/stats behavior. They do not by themselves establish a complete reproducible closure for every library, compiler, or link input.

source_facts.fact: cuMemCreate failures retain driver error, operation name, and OOM count.
PhysicalPage owns a VMM chunk. prepare_writes validates all pools, grows all pools, then performs private COW copies; a shared sealed page replacement reaches cuMemCreate.
begin marks session failed on prepare_writes failure and returns generic error. restore can reactivate a bound retained image and return ready on success.

source_facts.file: generated branch_driver.cpp (selected build input; not current src/core/branch_driver.cpp)
source_facts.fact: Generated driver handles failed generate with error_reply then continue; restore failure similarly replies and continues; stats is a subsequent command beginning at line 356 and exposes VMM OOM counters. The selected build input_sha256 pins this exact generated source; this is the driver source recorded for the selected binary.
NativeRequest treats status:error as invalid-token protocol failure and poisons Python adapter; later commands are refused.
Per-job worker catch continues with same model/backend; no backend recreation in this loop.

same_pipe_assessment.raw_driver: The selected generated driver source is independently rehashed and matches the path in build.json input_sha256. Its generate-error path replies and continues; restore-error also replies and continues; stats begins at line 356. This supports same-pipe stats/restore in source/build-input evidence, but has not been executed after CUDA OOM.
same_pipe_assessment.python_adapter: Current greedy adapter poisons on status:error; malformed-response poisoning remains required.
same_pipe_assessment.execution_status: NOT_EXECUTED; no GPU/native service run. Build-input provenance now includes generated branch_driver.cpp and relevant selected objects, but is not a full reproducible toolchain/link closure.
next_verification: With GPU0 exclusive and Q4 source warm, a test-only observer around StrataBackend._read waits for an owned active greedy iterator and captures its native terminal status:error.
Before returning that saved error to the unchanged iterator parser, observer sends stats on the same pipe and reads the response.
Require VMM OOM counter increment, CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY, last operation cuMemCreate. Do not turn the response into protocol success.
Then unchanged parser poisons adapter; release pressure in finally, restart service, and verify committed source/following request.
Keep a separate negative test proving malformed frames still poison.
same_pipe_assessment.observer_scope: Harness-only; no production source or native binary changes.

existing_coverage.core: tests/core/branch_pressure_test.cpp uses actual VMM allocation pressure, requires cuMemCreate OOM, releases pressure, restores root, retries COW write, and checks sibling bytes.
existing_coverage.model: experimental/branching_context/tests/gates/G3/test_pressure.py checks real OOM stats, no forward/capture/output/history mutation, releases pressure, then retries both branches and checks bytes/controllers.
existing_coverage.gap: Neither exercises production greedy HTTP wrapper. test_native_request_protocol.py tests malformed receipt/work poison, no valid terminal status:error.

unknowns: Same-process CUDA context behavior and native restore after a real cuMemCreate OOM remain unexecuted.
Multi-pool preparation may detach earlier private pages before a later OOM; an eventual runtime witness must inspect page/counter deltas and source immutability.

The collected input hashes bind the generated driver and selected relevant objects, but do not establish the complete compiler, library, and link-input closure needed to claim a reproducible full build.
